entries.text: A ruler who inherits power is better loved than a new ruler.
A ruler who does not go out of his way to get himself hated is better off.
A ruler should study the character of a people and a man of the people to know how to govern them.
A ruler should get to know the character of a people and a man of the people to know how to conquer them.
A ruler should achieve greatness that matches his status and qualities.
A ruler who occupies a new territory without considering the local customs and institutions is likely to face rebellion and instability.
A ruler who fails to eliminate the family of the previous ruler may lose power and control.
A ruler who prioritizes establishing colonies in the new territory is more likely to maintain stability and loyalty.
A ruler who has taken a new territory must prioritize eliminating the family of the previous ruler and establishing friendly relations with weaker neighbors.
A ruler who has taken a new territory must live among the people to improve security and stability.
A ruler who has taken a new territory must not allow foreign powers to gain influence in the new territory.
A ruler who has moved into a new region must make themselves leader and protector of the weaker neighboring powers.
A ruler must take care that no foreign power strong enough to compete with their own gets a chance to penetrate the area.
A ruler must not allow discontented people to encourage a foreign power to intervene.
Louis's mistakes in Italy led to the loss of Lombardy and ultimately the downfall of France.
The desire to conquer more territory is a natural thing, but it can also lead to ruin if not managed properly.

A ruler who has not forgotten the principles of their people will be able to rally them to fight for those principles at the first opportunity.
A people who have been accustomed to living under a ruler and have had their freedoms and traditions forgotten will be slower to rebel.
A ruler who has been accustomed to living under a ruler and has had their family eliminated will be slower to choose a new leader and live in freedom without one.
